test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The Sustainable Development Goals are a call for action by all countries-poor, rich and middle-income-to __promote__ prosperity while protecting the planet.
solution: The correct answer is '**boost**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word is '**promote**' is '**boost**'. • **Promote**: to encourage something; to help something to happen or develop. (किसी बात को प्रोत्‍साहित करना; किसी बात के होने या बढ़ने में सहायता करना) • *Example: to **promote** good relations between countries...* • **Boost**: to increase something in number, value or strength. (संख्‍या, मूल्‍य या शक्ति में वृद्धि करना) • *Example: If we lower the price, that should **boost** sales.*** **Correct Answer:__** *Boost.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **conceal**: to hide something/somebody; to prevent something/somebody from being seen or discovered. [(किसी से कुछ) छिपाना; गुप्‍त रखना] • **holistic**: relating to or concerned with wholes. (संपूर्ण रूप से) • **growl**: (used about dogs and other animals) to make a low noise in the throat to show anger or to give a warning. [(कुत्ते या अन्‍य जानवरों का) दूसरों पर ग़ुर्राना (ग़ुस्‍सा व्‍यक्त करने या चेतावनी देने के लिए)] 46:Tcd7, The correct answer is: Option 3** i.e. **pounding against the windows**.
